title: Local-work bound for the learner
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $M$ be a positive integer. For every output and cost pair in the support of the Kushilevitz–Mansour program run with target $f$, accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$, and parameter $M$, the number $w$ of charged local computation steps satisfies $w\le W+1280A^4(n+1)/\varepsilon^2$, where $A=\left\lceil 4/\tau^2\right\rceil$, $\tau=\varepsilon/(4M)$, and $W=n\left(C+2A\cdot 8\left(\left\lceil 2L/\eta^2\right\rceil+1\right)(n+1)\right)$, with $C=16(n+1)^2(A+1)^2$, $\eta=\tau^2/4$, and $\delta=1/[40(n+1)(A+1)]$, and $L=\left\lceil\log_2\left\lceil 2/\delta\right\rceil\right\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from the $n$-cube to signs
